other_conditions: Cultivable land‑holding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) with land records as of 01‑02‑2019 are eligible.
Eligibility is limited to families already eligible for the PM Kisan Yojana.
Benefits are credited only to Aadhaar‑linked bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Any benefit mistakenly credited to ineligible beneficiaries will be recovered as per PM Kisan SOP.
benefits_summary: Eligible farmer families receive Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments, transferred via DBT to their Aadhaar‑linked bank accounts.
